channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kyle Lowry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kyle Lowry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Edgecombe, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.”

Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
“I had Jodie Meeks, Norm Powell, Fred VanVleet, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Pascal Siakam and Danny Green. I learned a lot from those guys. I learned so much being out.”

Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Nick Nurse on the possibility of getting Lowry (who’s only played in 5 games this season) on the floor in this back-to-back vs the Raptors:

“Let’s see if we can throw him in these next few days.”

Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry, Jan 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Griffin casually dropped the news on a recent Pardon My Take appearance.

“Kyle Lowry is going to be our — actually, I don’t know if that one’s been announced,”

Blake Griffin on Kyle Lowry, Jun 13, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Caleb Martin on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Sam DiGiovanni:Caleb Martin on playing for NickNurse:

“I definitely think I fit, knowing the history of Nickand playing with guys and coaching guys. Kawhi, Kyle — Kyle Lowry, he's one of my big brothers right now, so anywhere he fits, I know I'll fit.”

Caleb Martin on Kyle Lowry, Jul 9, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Kyle Lowry, Robert Covington, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“I think the next game will be finally the one. We will have Tyrese [Maxey] and KL [Kyle Lowry] back. We got Joel. We just miss RoCo [Robert Covington].… I think we are more focused on [players returning]. We are focused on how we can be the best team past [Sunday].”

Nicolas Batum on Kyle Lowry, Robert Covington, Tyrese Maxey, Apr 11, 2024. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry:

“Nobody competes like that guy. I haven’t had a player in my entire coaching career that competes like that guy. That’s the highest compliment I can give him.”

Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry, Feb 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @NoahLevick.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry:

“Kyle's in a great place. We're talking about a highly-decorated, proven All-Star at that position.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Oct 25, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Jimmy Butler on Kyle Lowry:

“The world knows by now that I love that dude to death. He’s a winner.”

Jimmy Butler on Kyle Lowry, May 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Pascal Siakam on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Pascal Siakam on Kyle Lowry:

“He’s a big brother so it was good to see him… I always thought it was cool, I’m his beloved, he’s my beloved. He was always good vibes.”

Pascal Siakam on Kyle Lowry, Mar 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Sergio Scariolo on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
“During the playoffs, he was coming by before every game. He wanted me to sit down with him for 10 minutes and go through every aspect of the upcoming game. So, that was the evolution of our relationship. But at the beginning, it was like, 'Wow'. Kyle Lowry? Now, I would say he is one of my best buddies there [in the NBA], but at the beginning, it was like, 'Wow'. Let's say he's a guy who, to say the least, in terms of how he wants to show his status in the team. He's a lovely guy. I love him,”

Sergio Scariolo on Kyle Lowry, Jan 18, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry:

“We know what he can bring. He brings that championship, hall-of-fame quarterback play... he's a winner. He really impacts winning at both ends of the floor ... I was tired of competing against him.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Oct 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on resting Adebayo, Butler and Lowry tonight:

“We had a really good practice yesterday and a very good shootaround. It’s just our methodology of just getting ready for the season. Guys are getting their work and that’s the most important thing.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Oct 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Tim Hardaway on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
“Kyle Lowry is not fat. He’s not fat and overweight. He wears these football pads under him to make him look like he’s bigger. He’s way slimmer than what you think he is. I’ve been telling folks that for the longest. And everybody’s like, ‘No, he’s overweight.’ No, the guy is not overweight. It’s that he needs to stay healthy to stay in shape.”

Tim Hardaway on Kyle Lowry, Sep 3, 2022. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nurse on Lowry attending his charity golf tourney:

“I give him a lot of credit. I said, hey, we’re having a tournament and he said he’s in and has not wavered. For him to travel in and spend the time… it means a lot.”

Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry, Aug 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Pat Riley on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Pat Riley on Kyle Lowry’s conditioning:

“The bottom line with me and for me as far as hoping you can get the most out of a player…is that you have to be in world class shape, you just have to be.”

Pat Riley on Kyle Lowry, Jun 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Gabe Vincent
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Erik Spoelstra on Gabe Vincent stepping into Kyle Lowry’s spot:

“The whole team feels comfortable with him in that role, and he’s earned it.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Gabe Vincent, May 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Kyle Lowry, DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
“If I look at the template of Kyle Lowry and DeMar DeRozan, they started (ascending when they were) 27, or around that time,”

Masai Ujiri on Kyle Lowry, DeMar DeRozan, Feb 12, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nurse on not facing Lowry in Miami tonight:

“I wanted to see him, obviously... You go in here & you always wanna compete against the best players. Was kinda looking forward to seeing what that was gonna be like. We're gonna have to put that on hold... but we should see him soon.”

Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry, Jan 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nick Nurse on coaching against Kyle Lowry for the first time on Monday:

“I assume that he's gonna be ready to go and he'll be hard to handle... I would imagine he's gonna play super hard and he's gonna get his guys ready, and when he does that good things happen, we know that.”

Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry, Jan 15, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Kyle Guy
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Coach Spo on Kyle Guy:

“Tyler and Kyle Lowry were really looking for him... He's a gamer. So when he knocks down a couple, he's like several of our guys, he becomes ignitable.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Kyle Guy, Jan 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry sitting out tonight:

“The schedule is pretty intense... Those back to back games, we were going for the win in both of those. Then there was a quick turnaround in Utah.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Nov 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Pat Riley on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Pat Riley on Kyle Lowry:

“As long as we're winning a good percentage of our games, whatever Kyle does is gonna be a plus.”

Pat Riley on Kyle Lowry, Oct 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Pat Riley on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Pat Riley on Lowry:

“Kyle Lowry is a great leader and an exceptional defender. As a point guard, he will bring important skills to run the offense, score the ball and defend with the very best.”

Pat Riley on Kyle Lowry, Aug 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry's free agency:

“He still puts his body on the line. He still guards hard. He still scores, his numbers are good, his shooting percentages are good. And he's a tremendous talent. I hope we keep him. I think he's part of our core.”

Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry, May 21, 2021. Source: Apple Podcasts.

item.title: Malachi Flynn on Kyle Lowry, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Flynn on Lowry and VanVleet:

“Just watching those 2 guys over the last couple years, what I take from them is just how hard they compete. Being undersized you've gotta find a way to make up for that, you've gotta be tough, and they both do that on the defensive end.”

Malachi Flynn on Kyle Lowry, Fred VanVleet, Nov 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Masai Ujiri on Kyle Lowry:

“I don't want to say it's been up and down any more ... That guy is a stud. I don't want to start pushing him as a Hall of Famer, because I want 10 more years from this guy ... as he gets older, he gets better. I've never seen anything like it.”

Masai Ujiri on Kyle Lowry, Sep 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Brad Stevens on Kyle Lowry:

“He's an all-star but he might be the most underrated player in the league... He does everything you need to win. Somehow he's been under-appreciated, but I think the more people watch him in these setting the more people appreciate him.”

Brad Stevens on Kyle Lowry, Sep 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry:

“I'm not sure I've ever seen anybody play the game harder, any place I've ever coached or watching a game or anything. I don't know of any higher compliment I could give the guy than that. He does it all by sheer will and toughness.”

Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry, Sep 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nick Nurse on Lowry:

“He's looking awesome, like really awesome. He's really working hard... He's going at it everyday, very early in the morning.”

Nick Nurse on Kyle Lowry, Jul 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.
